in_english.name: Azziz
in_english.long_meaning: Azziz is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning strong, beloved, and noble. It is derived from the Arabic root ʿ-z-z, which conveys the idea of strength and power. The name Azziz is mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Al Imran and Surah Al Furqan, emphasizing its significance in Islamic tradition. It symbolizes strength, dignity, and high esteem.
